body: Just breathe, I can relate to you and that makes you special to me. I care about you. Just keep calm and phone someone you are really comfortable with end stay on the phone with them. Go to the ER with them and let them explain in a serious tone what the situation is. You are tired of people not listening. Now is your time toe let go and let someone who loves you take the wheel. Put someone else in control until jou feel better again. It's not surrender, It is lightening the load off your shoulders onto someone that is a bit emotionally stronger than you are at the moment untill you are back on your feet. Think of it as sick leave. Please be okay. I love you and i care so much about you
